column1: # MI1 (DUMB Korean VGA patch), L preset: 1 bpp, every charset (dialogue, sentence/verbs, card)
# in one pixel face at its 16 px design size, M1KO.MAP's render_target=clut8 preset.
# Fields: output 8.3 name, SCUMM charset, TTF, size, bpp, ascent.
# The cell is the charset's korean<NN>.fnt header doubled (bake-scumm-fonts.sh).
# Size rule (m5_sheets.py, pixel rows): min(cell w, cell h) // 16 * 16 = 16 for every cell here;
# a cell taller than 16 puts the 16 px face in the middle: ascent = 12 (the face's own ascent
# Charset 3 has the same 16x16 cell as charset 1, so one file serves both (M1KO.MAP's
# [fonts:clut8] names both M1L1.SVF); no korean05/06.fnt exists in this patch.
# M1L2 (charset 2, the dialogue: an 18x18 cell) is NanumGothic Bold at 17 px drawn by FreeType's monochrome
# renderer with the font's own hinting (--mono-hint, the eighth field; the seventh, "-", keeps the default limit):
# even whole-pixel stems, no blobs, where neodgm's 16 px was a 16 px face in an 18 px cell. $FONTS/nanum is the
# NHN NanumGothic package (fonts-nanum), the hinted original; the U preset uses Google's NanumGothic-Bold.
# The TTF field starts with $FONTS (default ~/scummvm-i18n/fonts; set FONTS=... to move it).
# The 24 px tall cells (M1L0, M1L4) are not baked from neodgm: jamoset.py writes them from Taebaek's 24 dot faces
# (SCUMM_FONTS.md, "24 dot faces"), so they have no row here.
